services.desc: Adult - $40 Child - $35 Private Charter - $1000 Night Out Charter - $1400 3 Hour Private Charter - $2000 1.5 Hour Public Tours, 2-3 Hour Private Tours The Ultimate Ocean City Tiki Adventure Get ready for a fun-fueled adventure as we take you on a tour through the stunning back bays of OCNJ aboard our magnificent 40′ Tour Boat. Whether you’re an early riser looking for a refreshing morning cruise, seeking a leisurely mid-day escapade, or craving a magical sunset experience, The Beachy Tiki has got you covered. Our tour is designed to cater to kids and adults of all ages, Public & Private Tours Daily: 8:30am - 10:30pm • 1.5 Hours

services.name: Aqua Park
services.desc: Action-packed inflatable aqua park with 20+ obstacles, supervised sessions, and provided life jackets for family-friendly water play. Ages 6+ • 45 minutes / Session • Group Available (Ages 4-7 on Small Splash)

services.name: Beachy Tiki - Little Tikis!
services.desc: Intimate and Fun-Filled Tiki Boat Adventure Ocean City’s ONLY Tiki Boat, The Beachy Tiki, offers private cruises for up to 6 people aboard their 25′ Tiki Boats. These smaller boats are perfect for an intimate and fun-filled experience on the water. Whether you’re looking for a morning cruise, a leisurely mid-day adventure, or an evening sunset cruise, The Beachy Tiki has something for everyone. Blast your favorite tunes and enjoy the ride! Free Water & Ice The Beachy Tiki provides free water and ice for all of their guests. So you can stay hydrated and cool while you’re cruising. Full Private Tiki - 6 People Included • Different duration options

services.name: Shark Bait Family Fishing Charter
services.desc: Shark Bait Fishing is a premier fishing charter business in the picturesque back bays of Ocean City, New Jersey, offering unforgettable and family-friendly fishing experiences. Specializing in creating memorable moments for both kids and adults of all ages, Shark Bait Fishing provides a safe and enjoyable environment for all skill levels. The back bays of Ocean City are teeming with a variety of fish species, including flounder, striped bass, bluefish, weakfish, and more, offering anglers a diverse and exciting fishing adventure. quotes.text: Perfect Family ActivityWe had an excellent sunset cruise with the Beachy Tiki. Our family loved the comfortable boat, great hospitality and breathtaking taking bay views of Ocean City. This boat is great for kids and perfect for a family reunion. We will certainly be back!– Kathy, TripAdvisor

Sunset CruiseBeautiful relaxing cruise at sunset with a wonderful crew. We celebrated my wife’s birthday with the entire family (13 of us), including my elderly parents. The crew were friendly and eager to offer a helping hand. Highly recommend this experience!– kochbri, TripAdvisor

Awesome Low Key Boat RideLoved it! Wouldn’t change anything about the experience. We did the 6:30 pm and we were able to see a beautiful sunset. We had a three year old with us and the speed was a comfortable pace for him.– Meg L, TripAdvisor
